description: This file implements Unix domain socket server management functions, including creating, checking for existing servers, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: int is_another_server_alive(const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts)
methods.description: Checks if there is an active server listening on the specified Unix domain socket by attempting a connection.

methods.name: int unix_ss_create(const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts,long timeout_ms,struct unix_ss_socket ** new_server_socket)
methods.description: Creates a new Unix stream server socket at the specified path if no server is already listening, handling lock management to prevent race conditions.

methods.name: void unix_ss_free(struct unix_ss_socket * server_socket)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a Unix stream server socket, including closing the socket and deleting its file if not stolen.

methods.name: int unix_ss_was_stolen(struct unix_ss_socket * server_socket)
methods.description: Checks if the server socket file has been replaced or invalidated, indicating the server has been stolen or terminated unexpectedly.

ctags.name: unix_ss_create
ctags.signature: (const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts,long timeout_ms,struct unix_ss_socket ** new_server_socket)
